limitations: Text-key to text-key geometry is not speech-query retrieval performance.
TRAIN labels are analysis targets; DEV, FoldB and TEST are not loaded.
Self and every exact-text duplicate are excluded from all nearest-neighbor statistics.
Global kNN purity and hubness depend on class sizes; per-label competitor margins reduce but do not eliminate imbalance.
Negative margin is not proof of annotation error and does not authorize deleting or relabeling a source.
No knowledge-bank selection policy has yet been accepted or deployed.
